system.description:
Also, at 2nd Level, you and your Bonded creature are so uniquely acquainted that when you fight, you feel far more

like a single entity. When you summon your Bonded creature, your wills bleed into one another, allowing you to pull off feats of teamwork unheard of by other practitioners of Summoning. You and your summon gain the listed abilities based on their primary roles.

Strikers. Once per turn, when your summon score two hits with an attack as part of the attack action or casting a jutsu, you regain 1 Focus.

Caster. Once per turn, while in combat, when your summon casts a jutsu spending a Jutsu Slot, you regain 1 Focus.

Controller. Once per turn, when your summon casts a Jutsu that at least one creature fails their saving throw against, you regain 1 Focus.

| #### Crash Duality / Will Amp / Once per casting, you gain a +1d10 bonus to damage you deal with Ninjutsu you cast. This increases to +2d10 at 11th, and 3d10 at 19th level. / You can use two or more Moldings at once as part of the same casting. / You can use the Draw Reserves skill Action, as an Action. / You do not benefit from the cost reduction any source. Casting a Jutsu at 0 Cost does not count as cost reduction. |

Defender. Once per turn, your summon can spend their Reaction to interpose taking the damage from an attack targeting you while they are within 10 feet of you.

| #### Flow Duality / Will Amp / You gain a +1 bonus to your Ninjutsu Save DC. This bonus increases to +2 at 15th level. / When you being your turn in this state, you regain 1 Focus. / If you are a Bonded creature, you instead regain 1 Jutsu Slot. / You make Concentration checks to maintain Ninjutsu at advantage. / You cannot benefit from Jutsu, features or traits that boosts the damage you deal with Ninjutsu. |

Lurker. Once per turn, when your summon deals their Lethal Attack damage, you can teleport into a space up within 20 feet of them that you can see.

Supporter. Once per turn, when your summon restores hit points, chakra points or grants temporary hit points or chakra points to another creature, as part of the action used to apply them you or your summon can reduce the rank of a condition you (or it) has by 1.
